name: ChatBI Text2SQL 评估用例集
description: 覆盖单表过滤、多表 JOIN、聚合、时间计算、汇率折算、费用层级、毛利等业务规则的黄金 SQL 用例。

cases.question: 查询已完成订单的总数量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales_orders WHERE order_status = 'completed';
rules: 订单统计必须过滤 completed

cases.question: 查询德国客户数量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM dim_customers WHERE country = 'Germany';

cases.question: 按客户类型统计已完成订单数量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT c.customer_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_type;
rules: 订单统计必须过滤 completed

cases.question: 按产品线统计不含税收入
cases.golden_sql: SELECT p.product_line, SUM(o.net_amount) AS revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_line;
rules: 订单统计必须过滤 completed

cases.question: 查询2026年第一季度的总费用
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(rd_expense + selling_expense + admin_expense + finance_expense) AS total_expense FROM finance_expenses WHERE expense_date >= '2026-01-01' AND expense_date < '2026-04-01';
rules: 费用汇总不得重复计算子项

cases.question: 欧洲市场最近三个月的销售额（人民币）
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(o.net_amount * e.rate_to_cny) AS revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN exchange_rates e ON o.order_date = e.rate_date AND o.currency = e.currency WHERE o.region = '欧洲' AND o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH);
rules: 多币种收入按汇率折算人民币

cases.question: 本月各部门的研发费用
cases.golden_sql: SELECT department, SUM(rd_expense) AS rd_total FROM finance_expenses WHERE expense_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND expense_date <= CURDATE() GROUP BY department;
rules: 本月指当月1日至当前日期

cases.question: 各产品线的毛利率
cases.golden_sql: SELECT p.product_line, (SUM(o.net_amount) - SUM((p.material_cost + p.labor_cost) * o.quantity)) / SUM(o.net_amount) AS gross_margin FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_line;

cases.question: 查询所有已取消的订单编号
cases.golden_sql: SELECT order_no FROM sales_orders WHERE order_status = 'cancelled';

cases.question: 统计各销售区域的订单金额（人民币）
cases.golden_sql: SELECT o.region, SUM(o.net_amount * e.rate_to_cny) AS revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN exchange_rates e ON o.order_date = e.rate_date AND o.currency = e.currency WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.region;
rules: 多币种收入按汇率折算人民币

cases.question: 查询储能集成商客户的数量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM dim_customers WHERE customer_type = '储能集成商';

cases.question: 查询换电运营商客户所在的国家
cases.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM dim_customers WHERE customer_type = '换电运营商';

cases.question: 统计各技术路线产品的平均标准成本
cases.golden_sql: SELECT tech_route, AVG(standard_cost) AS avg_standard_cost FROM dim_products GROUP BY tech_route;
rules: 明确问标准成本时才用 standard_cost

cases.question: 查询销售费用最高的三个部门
cases.golden_sql: SELECT department, SUM(selling_expense) AS total_selling FROM finance_expenses GROUP BY department ORDER BY total_selling DESC LIMIT 3;

cases.question: 查询2026年6月所有已完成订单的毛利
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(o.net_amount - (p.material_cost + p.labor_cost) * o.quantity) AS gross_profit FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01';
rules: 订单统计必须过滤 completed

cases.question: 查询含税销售额最高的产品名称
cases.golden_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(o.gross_amount) AS gross_revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;
rules: 明确问含税时才用 gross_amount
